consequence.statement: Envoy statistics are now created lazily by default, which saves memory and CPU cycles when stats are not referenced; the previous behavior of creating all statistics upfront can be restored by setting ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION to false.

original.statement: An experimental environment variable ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION was added to the agent Deployment to control lazy creation of Envoy statistics; the feature is enabled by default and can be disabled by setting it to false.

decision.reason: [ev-62f858bc5c83] describes an experimental feature that lazily creates a subset of Envoy statistics to save memory and CPU, and says it can be turned off by setting ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION to false in the agent Deployment. That implies it is on by default but does not say so. Nothing fails, is rejected or stops being honoured: stats are just created differently, so behavior-change with low severity (review) is the right kind and class. One caveat on wording: the proposed statement says "Envoy statistics" and "all statistics upfront", while the evidence says only "a subset". The kind and remediation are still correct.
